exposure: Infants of pregestational diabetic mothers vs. infants of gestational diabetic mothers
Infants of diabetic mothers (pregestational and gestational)
cohort: Infants admitted to the neonatal care unit
finding: Infants of diabetic mothers experienced higher rates of hypoglycemia, macrosomia, and hyperbilirubinemia compared to infants of non-diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: 86% of infants of diabetic mothers were born by caesarean section.
birth_weight: Macrosomia in 64% of infants of diabetic mothers
